title: eval-harness: add per-prompt regression CI hooks and quality-gating integration
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Add per-prompt regression CI hooks and quality gating. Enables finer-grained blocking on prompt-set regressions and exports per-prompt metrics to CI. No user-facing API changes.
description:
Motivation: Our current eval-harness CI gates operate at the suite level which makes it hard to identify regressions driven by a small subset of prompts. This PR adds per-prompt regression CI hooks and a quality-gating integration so that PRs can be blocked based on regressions on high-priority prompts, and teams can tune per-prompt thresholds independently.

What this change does: Implements a new per-prompt CI hook that runs as part of the eval CI workflow. The hook computes per-prompt pass/fail statistics, compares against baseline metrics stored in the eval-metrics store, and applies configurable gating rules (absolute delta, relative change, minimum sample size). The gating configuration lives in eval-harness/config/per_prompt_gates.yml and supports: allowlist of high-priority prompts, threshold types (pass_rate_delta, absolute_pass_rate), and severity (warning/block). The CI workflow (ci/workflows/eval_ci.yml) has been updated to upload detailed per-prompt metrics as artifacts and to fail the job if any gate configured with severity=block is violated.

Implementation summary: - eval-harness/ci/hooks/per_prompt_hook.py: new entrypoint that reads metrics from the evaluator, fetches baseline data from eval-harness/metrics/baselines/, computes deltas and applies gates. - eval-harness/gating/quality_gate.py: reusable gating engine used by both per-prompt and existing suite-level gates. - eval-harness/metrics/exporter.py: extended to emit per-prompt details (pass_rate, sample_count, median_confidence) and to write baselines during gold-run mode. - ci/workflows/eval_ci.yml: runs the per-prompt hook and uploads artifacts. - docs/eval-harness/per_prompt_ci.md: documents configuration and recommended thresholds for canary rollout. - tests/eval/test_per_prompt_gating.py: unit/integration tests for gating logic and edge cases.

Testing & validation performed: - Local unit tests covering gating logic (edge cases: low sample counts, NaN metrics). - Integration tests that simulate a regression on a single prompt and assert the CI job fails when the gate is blocking. - End-to-end run against a staging model (gold-run) to generate baseline artifacts and verify metric export. - CI run on this PR: all checks passed after fixing a flake in the metrics exporter.

Rollout plan: 1) Merge to main behind a feature flag controlled by eval-harness/config/flags.yml. 2) Enable per-prompt gating for a small set of repos (platform team) using an allowlist. 3) Monitor false-positive rate for 2 weeks; tune thresholds and increase minimum sample sizes. 4) Gradually expand to more repos and flip default to opt-in.

Checklist: - [x] Add per-prompt hook implementation - [x] Integrate gating engine - [x] Export per-prompt metrics from evaluator - [x] Update CI workflow to consume per-prompt artifacts - [x] Add documentation and examples - [x] Tests added and passing

Notes: This is intentionally conservative with blocking thresholds to avoid noisy failures on low-volume prompts. Follow-up work (ENG-4150) will add an automatic bucketing strategy to combine low-volume prompts with similar semantic labels to avoid high variance.

Related: Linear ENG-4123 (per-prompt CI hooks), ENG-4150 (gating heuristics). Support ticket SUP-879 requested finer-grained gating for enterprise customers.
